sloka: स तत्र कैलासनिभाः स्वलंकृताः ।प्रविश्य कक्ष्यास्त्रिदशालयोपमाः ।प्रियान् वरान् राममते स्थितान् बहून् ।व्यपोह्य शुद्धांतमुपस्थितो रथी ॥२-१५-४३॥
transliteration: sa tatra kailāsanibhāḥ svalaṁkṛtāḥ ।praviśya kakṣyāstridaśālayopamāḥ ।priyān varān rāmamate sthitān bahūn ।vyapohya śuddhāṁtamupasthito rathī ॥2-15-43॥

translations.english: Having entered the welldecorated palace which was (lofty) like Kailasa, he crossed the courtyards comparable to the abode of the celestials, passed through the many bosom friends of Rama and entered the private apartment.
